description: Agent Legal: submit an order form with the agreement’s pricing terms and the quote it follows: the order form with its reference, the agreement and quote it cites, the currency, each line with its id, item, quantity, unit price and amount, the total and the renewal term in months; the pricing terms with their reference, the currency, each priced item with its unit price and any committed quantity, and the renewal term; the quote with its reference, the currency and each line with its id, item, quantity and unit price. The signed report gives the order form, the pricing terms and the quote, each line paired with its priced item and quote line, each unit price against the pricing terms, each quantity against the committed quantity and the quote, the renewal term on both sides, each line amount recomputed as quantity times unit price and the total recomputed as the sum of the lines, and each quoted line dropped and each order line added, and counts them, and names a divergent order form: another currency, a unit price, quantity or renewal term unlike the pricing terms or the quote, a line or total that does not recompute, and quoted scope the order form drops or adds to; then an ordered item the pricing terms do not name and another agreement or quote reference, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A unit price or quantity the pricing terms or the quote state and the order line leaves out, a renewal term the pricing terms set and the order form leaves out, an order form with no lines, or pricing terms with no priced item or renewal term leaves the order form unverified. Lines pair by their item’s words with plurals folded, amounts compare to the cent in one currency and quantities to the thousandth. Verdict legal_order_form_divergent, legal_order_form_partial, legal_order_form_unverified or legal_order_form_consistent. POST /api/legal-order-form-check. Reads the contract records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never drafts, negotiates, signs or files anything, judges no fairness of terms and no readiness of a deal to settle, and leaves enforceability, interpretation and legal advice to lawyers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Legal reads contract records across the agreement lifecycle for consistency between documents: an executed agreement, a statement of work, an order form, an amendment, an execution record, a renewal or termination notice, the exhibits attached to an agreement and an assignment record, each against the term sheet or deal summary, the master agreement, the pricing terms and the quote, the agreement it amends, the signature requirements, the notice clause, the exhibits the agreement references or the assignment clause it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral and compares different documents with each other, not versions of one document. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-legal-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-legal/.
